about: Every effect estimate in this project in one schema: rate, odds and hazard ratios with 95% CIs from the lenses' committed result tables, ACS one-year incidence by group (descriptive), and verified primary literature records. Numbers are copied, never computed; each entry names its source file and row (or evidence record id). Estimates from different lenses use different outcomes, populations, horizons and adjustment sets and must not be pooled or compared as if they were the same quantity. Cross-sectional entries are measured after any divorce.

schema.predictor: input or term as the source names it
schema.measure: odds ratio / rate ratio / hazard ratio / risk ratio / group rate per 1,000
schema.ci95: 95% interval as published by the source
schema.adjusted: true if from a multivariable model
schema.timing: when the predictor was measured relative to the outcome
schema.source: file and 1-based data row (or record id)
